text:
Maya (docs): quick heads-up: i'm starting a small migration of the Dedicated Capacity docs. goal: make a lean provisioning quickstart and move all policy/scale examples to a separate "Scaling & Policies" page. opening WIP PR in ~1h. any immediate concerns?

Alex (platform): sounds good. pls make sure we standardize resource names across TF examples. we have both `reserved_pool_id` and `pool_id` floating around in internal examples.

Sanjay (infra): agreed on naming. i'd prefer `reserved_capacity` as the resource name in TF examples (matches runtime naming). also flag: we need a short blurb explaining eviction vs preemption semantics for Dedicated pools. current doc fragments are inconsistent.

Kevin (runtime): i'll update the SDK snippets. runtime recently renamed `allocate_pool` to `create_reserved_capacity`. i'll post the new JS and Python examples.

Priya (eng-sre): i'll run a quick smoke on the terraform examples once Sanjay posts the canonical resource. i can also validate the rollout guidance wording (canary vs immediate).

Maya (docs): perfect. planning to include these sections on the new Scaling & Policies page: Overview, Policy examples (threshold, schedule, burst), SDK snippets, TF examples, Rollout & canary notes, SLA summary card. who's doing TF and who does SDK edits?

Sanjay (infra): i'll own TF naming and a minimal example. quick snippet i want in the doc (please review):

```
resource "redwood_reserved_capacity" "team_alpha" {
  name   = "team-alpha"
  gpus   = 4
  region = "us-west-2"
  preemption_policy = "best_effort"
}
```

Alex (platform): that matches the current infra model. add `preemption_policy` and `eviction_precedence` notes below the snippet.

Kevin (runtime): SDK examples i'll push: JS and Python. JS snippet will be:

```js
// create a reserved capacity
const cap = await client.create_reserved_capacity({
  name: "team-alpha",
  gpus: 4,
  region: "us-west-2",
});
```

Priya (eng-sre): nice. small request: include an example of fallback routing in case reserved capacity is exhausted. even a one-liner is helpful.

Maya (docs): will add fallback note: "requests may route to burst capacity or compatible model variants per routing policy; may increase latency and cost." any objections to that phrasing?

Sanjay (infra): good. also add a tiny Eviction precedence table (one-line) that says: reserved capacity (guaranteed) > burst capacity (best-effort) > regional fallback.

DocsBot: link-check started for branch/migration.

DocsBot: link-check results: 3 external 404s, 1 internal redirect. see /internal/link-check/1764449999.

Maya (docs): i'll run link fixes in the PR and replace internal runbook links with public runbook aliases where possible. will also put the SLA summary in a boxed card for screenshots.

Kevin (runtime): FYI: we changed the metric name from `reserved_pool_utilization` to `reserved_capacity_utilization` — update any graph snippets and prometheus query examples. i'll drop a quick commit.

Alex (platform): thanks. also, please ensure the TF examples use variables for `region`/`name` to avoid hardcoding. we have a small linter that flags hardcoded regions.

Maya (docs): checklist before merge: 1) TF naming & examples updated (Sanjay) 2) SDK snippets updated (Kevin) 3) metric/query names fixed (Kevin) 4) link-check green (Maya) 5) SLA card copy (Maya + Alex) 6) eng-sre smoke (Priya). target: EOD merge if CI/link-check pass.

Priya (eng-sre): i'll sign off on smoke tests after TF commit. no blockers.

Sanjay (infra): i'll push TF patch tonight and ping this thread when done.

Kevin (runtime): pushing SDK + metrics rename now.

Maya (docs): thanks all :thumbsup: will post PR URL here once created and keep the PR description clear about owners for each section. ping me if anything blocks merging.
